author: GamingBolt
description:
Spark in the Dark feels incredibly promising in its current state. While far from feeling complete, the lack of enemy variety, ineffective tutorials, and clunky combat stand out; however, I still found the game surprisingly addictive. The minimalist approach to storytelling, with plenty of vague hints and clues about what might be happening in the world, is great. 

The core gameplay loop has a certain “one more run” quality that keeps bringing me back. However, Stellar Fish certainly has its work cut out for it as it continues its journey through Early Access.
title: Spark In The Dark Early Access Review - Does It Scratch the Dark Souls Itch?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Pragmata probably won't stand out as the greatest of all time. It may get buried under the sheer barrage of releases in the coming weeks and months. However, judging by the critical success and the positive buzz from players, it made a strong impression. 

Hopefully, it ends up lasting well beyond that reasonable playtime and into a well-deserved sequel.
title: Pragmata Proves AAA Games Don't Need To Be 30 Hours Long

author: GamingBolt
description:
The early reviews of Crimson Desert were quite emphatic about its problems. However, a bunch of speedy patches have more or less resolved all those problems in less than a month. The game has managed to raise important questions about the relevance of release build reviews, but it has also created discourse around the need for new ones to replace them. 

But is that a good or a bad thing? That’s what we’re here to discuss. We'll dive into how the game’s evolution into what it was always meant to be showcases how a modern release can become an entirely different beast very soon after its original build goes live. 

Join us as we take a look at how that could, and perhaps should, affect the review process as Crimson Desert joins a growing list of successful redemption arcs in modern gaming.
title: Crimson Desert Is The Rare Big Game Whose Early Verdicts May Have Already Expired
